endCondition.description: After round 7: eliminate players with negative money, deduct offspring from Popularity, score conservation projects, spend all money on construction, then compare

notes: Competitive base and New Shores 2–4 players. Guided inputs are tracks before final scoring, offspring in enclosures, New Shores eggs in enclosures (never Vivarium eggs), filled Vivarium sections, park points, breeding track, welfare species counts, and actual final construction track changes. Projects/welfare scored before final building. Negative-money players are excluded. Two-player breeding second place requires the leader’s segment and welfare awards no second place. Welfare points are distributed one at a time across the lower tracks; on equal tracks choose which receives the next point. Solo/co-op not modelled.
